question: Sonal Mansingh is mainly associated with which dance style?
solution:
The correct answer is __Bharatnatyam and Odissi__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Sonal Mansingh is a prominent Indian classical dancer who specializes in Bharatanatyam and Odissi.
 
• For her contributions to promoting ‘Classical dances’, she has received accolades from many national and international organizations.
 
• She was the youngest recipient of Padma Bhushan in 1992.
 
• In 2003, Sonal became the first Indian woman dancer to be awarded Padma Vibhushan.
